import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0200 {α : Type _} (l1 l2 : List α) : (l1.reverse ++ l2.reverse).reverse = (l1 ++ l2).reverse := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0200 {α : Type _} (l1 l2 : List α) : (l1.reverse ++ l2.reverse).reverse = (l1 ++ l2).reverse := by
  induction l1 l2 with
  | nil _ => reverse (reverse (Nil) ++ l2.reverse) = reverse (l2.reverse ++ Nil)  trivial
  | cons _ l1' l2' ih => reverse (l1.reverse ++ l2'.reverse) = reverse (l1' ++ l2.reverse)  trivial
END BY

END BY.
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0200 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0200 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0200

run_cmd do
  let expectedInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0200
  let candidateInfo ← Lean.getConstInfo `Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0200
  unless expectedInfo.levelParams.length == candidateInfo.levelParams.length do
    throwError "Fixed theorem universe-parameter arity mismatch"
  let candidateType := candidateInfo.type.instantiateLevelParams candidateInfo.levelParams (expectedInfo.levelParams.map Lean.Level.param)
  Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM do
    unless (← Lean.Meta.isDefEq expectedInfo.type candidateType) do
      throwError "Fixed theorem closed declaration types differ"
